North Bengal Floods:  West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee raised concerns over flood mismanagement, citing water release from DVC and Bhutan as key causes. With Kalimpong disconnected and Nagrakata, Mirik among the worst affected, she urged tourists to stay put until rescue. A 24/7 control room has been set up as the death toll in North Bengal floods crosses 20. CM Banerjee is visiting the flood-hit regions today.
